title: Company settings
description: Rules for orders, order location, field work and deliveries — sent to every phone on sync

profile.title: Company profile
profile.help: Shown as text on invoices and load sheets (no logo).
profile.name: Company name
profile.codeHelp: Staff type this in the app. Ask Onukrom support to change it.

orders.title: Orders
orders.help: How orders from the field are checked
orders.autoApproveHelp: Skip the approval step — good for small companies
orders.priceWindowHelp: Old prices accepted this long after a price change
orders.blockOverStockHelp: Checked in the office when approving

location.title: Order location
location.help: Live GPS taken at the shop for every order, delivery and payment
location.modeHelp: Required: an order cannot be saved without a GPS fix
location.waitHelp: Then save with the best fix and flag it
location.geofenceHelp: Orders further than this are flagged
location.blockMockHelp: Off: save and flag. On: the order is rejected
location.shopFromOrder: Set shop location from first order
location.shopFromOrderHelp: For shops that have no saved location yet
location.flagWarning: Orders without a GPS fix will be accepted and only flagged. Use this only if many shops have poor GPS signal.

field.title: Field work
field.startDayHelp: Staff must start the day before taking orders
field.dutyHelp: Records the route while on duty (shows a notification)
field.oneDeviceHelp: Logging in on a new phone signs out the old one

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.proofHelp: Asked for when the delivery man marks an order delivered

sms.title: SMS
sms.help: Used for invites and password resets
sms.dailyCapHelp: Protects against accidental or abusive sending

toast.saved: Settings saved — phones get them on the next sync
